strongest_angle: Analyze how newly discovered gold ingots found in an inactive toilet tank during October 2026 raids by Prefectura Naval Argentina provide crucial forensic evidence for a December 2025 disappearance in Caleta Olivia.

key_facts.fact: Prefectura Naval Argentina recovered four gold ingots weighing over two and a half kilos hidden inside the water tank of an inactive toilet during raids in Caleta Olivia on October 9, 2026.
The investigation and raids conducted by Prefectura Naval Argentina stem from the disappearance of a man on December 7, 2025, in the Santa Cruz locality of Caleta Olivia.
During the October 2026 operations in Caleta Olivia, personnel from Prefectura Naval Argentina also seized an automobile, a DVR recording system, and two cell phones from the property.
